rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 5 cohorts (HCP Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging, UK Biobank) from multiple sites and scanners; site included as covariate in the normative model
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "we assembled high-quality multi-shell diffusion data from five cohorts having closely matched acquisition and processing pipelines, namely Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging datasets, and UK Biobank"; "The model incorporated several covariates, including sex, age, and dummy coded race, and site."
rci1_using_msad.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Results / Normative modelling, L121; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling, L205

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP (Baby, Development, Young Adult, Aging subsets) and UK Biobank used for normative model construction
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "By using high-quality diffusion MRI data from the UK Biobank and the Human Connectome Project, we seek to establish robust models that capture lifespan trajectories of white matter organization"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging subsets all fall under the HCP umbrella; UK Biobank imaging cohort
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging datasets, and UK Biobank"
